'''2001 Phoenix DPC''' was a Star Wars CCG DPC held in Phoenix, Arizona on 7 September 2001. It is known from Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3047">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-11-dpc-phoenix-epilogued3047/ dpc-phoenix-epilogue], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 11 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-11-dpc-phoenix-epilogued3047/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Phoenix, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 25
